text.name: Mullich's Helm of Leadership
text.description:
{Mullich's Helm of Leadership}

All friendly creatures get +1 speed and +2 morale.
text.event: "All items are of excellent quality!" – the merchant shouted. Curious, you stopped to look at his goods. Immediately your gaze fell on Mullich's Helm of Leadership. What a find! Having staged a whole show, you persuaded the merchant to give it to you for a few silver coins. After paying, you quickly left the place.
